newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ten arrested for ambush of Pakistani police.
newsitem.headline: Ten arrested for ambush of Pakistani police.

text.p: Pakistani authorities have arrested 10 people for an ambush of policemen apparently motivated by a local vendetta, officials said on Wednesday.
"The shooting was the result of a tribal feud," an official said of Tuesday's ambush in Larkana, home town of ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto, in the southern province of Sindh.
Six policemen and a small girl were killed when gunmen in a car fired on a police van on its way to a Larkana court.
The official, who asked not to be named, said police had arrested one police officer and nine other people in connection with the attack, saying three of the suspects had confessed.
He said three police investigation teams had been set up and vehicles leaving Larkana were checked at road blocks.
Witnesses said more than 100 men had fled Hussainabad, near Larkana, for fear of a police crackdown. The village is home to Khoso tribesmen said to have been involved in the attack.
